alex: Heads up — we need to run a short design walkthrough for the new Unified API + SDK auth flow and console settings. Goal: align on request/response shapes, default retry behavior, and the console UX for toggling experimental features. Who's available next Tue/Wed afternoon? Also what should be in the pre-read?
Priya: I'm free Wed 2-3pm PT. For pre-read: API contract doc, SDK usage examples, and screenshots of console flows. Can someone drop links?
alex: Great — Wed 2pm PT works. I'll book 45m. Pre-reads: I'll attach a 1-page 'what to look for' checklist + current API proto + a short demo GIF. @casey can you add the SDK snippet? @jonah can you drop the Figma frames?
casey: Added SDK snippet to the draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/482 — it's minimal. Note: it includes new auth header `X-RW-Client`.
jonah: Figma frames here: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/unified-console — frames 12-15 show the toggles. Also left a comment about placement.
taylor: Quick checklist suggestion: 1) Verify API error shapes, 2) Identify migration path for old SDKs, 3) Check telemetry keys for feature flags. I'll review pre-read today.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: Wed 2026-03-18 14:00 PT — Calendar invite sent to alex, Priya, casey, jonah, taylor.
alex: Thanks — agenda pinned in the invite. If you spot anything blocking in the PR or Figma before EOD please flag here. :thumbsup:
